note: QMTech Wukong V1 per fpga/HARDWARE_SSOT.md. The CI sweep routes xc7a200tfbg484-2 (AX7203): DIFFERENT package AND speed grade, so these figures are not comparable to the CI's and are not offered as such.

flow.xdc: generated, IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33 on all 54 pads, NO package pins -- the placer chose IO sites, which the CI's board xdc fixes

reproducibility: Fmax reproduces exactly on a re-run; log_sha256 does not, because nextpnr logs wall-clock timings. The hashes pin the shipped logs rather than predicting a re-run.
finding: 5 placer seeds on ONE netlist give Fmax 379.65-422.65 MHz, a spread of 10.5% of the median, while the LUT count is identical in all of them. Area is seed-invariant here; timing is not. A frequency quoted to 0.01 MHz from an unstated number of seeds is over-precise against its own reproducibility.
